blocks.text: ``bash file mystery.bin # magic bytes → real type exiftool image.jpg # metadata: GPS, camera, date, software binwalk firmware.bin # find embedded files / signatures strings -n 8 binary # extract printable strings ``

rows: Extract hidden data from JPEG (needs passphrase)
Visual analysis — bit planes, color channels

items: Flag in image EXIF metadata → exiftool
Flag appended after image data → strings or binwalk
Flag in least significant bits of pixels → zsteg / stegsolve
Flag in alpha channel of transparent PNG → bit plane analysis
Audio: spectrogram contains text → Audacity / Sonic Visualiser

blocks.text: ```bash # Wireshark — open .pcap, look at: HTTP, FTP, DNS, TCP streams # Right-click packet → Follow → TCP Stream → see full conversation
# Command-line (tshark) tshark -r capture.pcap -Y "http.request" -T fields -e http.host -e http.request.uri ```
Common PCAP findings: credentials in HTTP, files in FTP transfers, DNS exfiltration patterns, base64 in HTTP POST bodies.
